releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.168: My Documents multi-word search, matching signed APK and Check for Update feed. Existing documents, saved images, notes, PIN, reminders and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Memories duplicate image preview removed. One saved image now displays as a single thumbnail; tapping it opens the existing full-size image viewer. Existing saved data and download action are preserved.
